result.title: CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 39 pages, including supplementary material and the NeurIPS paper checklist. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA
result.summary: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CondenseVLA，在 VLA 策略的解码端用可学习 query 与多头交叉注意力，把缓存的多帧视觉特征蒸馏为固定数量的 slot token 供动作解码，并以辅助正则抑制 slot 注意力重叠、降低冗余，从而在有限历史窗口内利用短期视觉证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可学习 query + 交叉注意力 + 冗余正则」的固定潜状态压缩，可为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态设计与信息坍缩问题提供方法线索；但该工作面向机器人动作解码而非推理主线，作者也指出更难的多观测任务受有限窗口限制，这一长度/历史瓶颈与 latent 长度泛化问题可供核查。
